name: com.studiogaku.input-assist
description: Inspector-friendly 2D input filtering and button gesture tracking with explicit time and no Input System dependency, plus allocation-free deterministic value types for radial dead zone, response curve, slew limit, exponential smoothing, direction limit, weighted mixing, axis and direction quantization, threshold hysteresis, press, repeat, and multi-tap classification.

samples.description: Ready-to-open vector filtering and button gesture controls with responsive UI Toolkit output.
Inner, mid, outer, over-range, non-finite rejection, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Compares four magnitude curves, explicit range rejection, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
One-step, repeated-step, diagonal, target reach, rejection, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Compares repeated filtering steps, exact factor-one arrival, explicit rejection, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Compares counter-clockwise, clockwise, repeated, opposite-tie, rejection, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry scenarios.
Compares equal and unequal weights, zero and empty inputs, explicit rejection, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Radial dead-zone, four-way tie, eight-way sectors, non-finite rejection, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Dead-zone, symmetric quantization, clamping, non-finite rejection, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Inclusive release and press boundaries, hysteresis retention, non-finite rejection, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Tap, hold start, hold completion, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry from explicit ticks.
Immediate press, delayed repeat, tick-jump catch-up, release, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
Pending tap windows, gap completion, maximum-count completion, and responsive UI Toolkit geometry.
